title: Moving the Presentation
transcript:
Good morning. Could our group move its presentation to another day? One of us has a work shift on Tuesday.
Your group is first on Tuesday, at ten. I can offer you Thursday at eleven or Friday at two.
Thursday won’t work. We all have a lab until twelve. Can we take Friday?
Yes. But I still need your slides by Wednesday evening. I’ll put them on the classroom computer before class.
Should we each send a copy?
No, please choose one person to send the complete file.
All right. I’ll send it myself.

questions.prompt: Why does the student want a different date?
options: The group needs to collect more data.
A group member has to work.
questions.answer: A group member has to work.
questions.explanation: 组里一位同学周二需要上班。

questions.prompt: When should the group submit its slides?
questions.explanation: 虽改到周五展示，仍要在周三晚上之前交幻灯片。
